nodes.description: Public mapping balanceOf in StandardToken tracking per-address token balances, mutated without SafeMath.
Public nested mapping allowance in StandardToken tracking spender approvals, mutated without SafeMath.
Private owner address of StandardToken, set from msg.sender in the constructor and used as the sole access-control authority.
Constant internal UNI router address 0x7a250d...488D hardcoded in StandardToken.
Public totalSupply of StandardToken, minted entirely to the deployer.
Public token name string of StandardToken.
Public token symbol string of StandardToken.
Constant public decimals = 18 in StandardToken.
Private _balances mapping inside the ERC20 base contract.
Private nested _allowances mapping inside the ERC20 base contract.
Private _totalSupply inside the ERC20 base contract.
StandardToken.transferFrom: guarded by ensure modifier, performs unchecked balance/allowance -= and += operations.
StandardToken.transfer: delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
StandardToken.approve: sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] directly without checks.
StandardToken.delegate: owner-only arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-supplied address and calldata.
StandardToken.batchSend: owner-only loop that computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath and mints transfers.
StandardToken constructor: sets name, symbol, supply, owner and pre-approves the router for uint(-1).
ensure(_from,_to) modifier: recomputes the Uniswap pair via pairFor and requires _from/_to to be owner or the computed pair.
pairFor: computes a Uniswap pair address from a hardcoded init code hash.
ERC20.transfer: calls _transfer(_msgSender(), recipient, amount).
ERC20.transferFrom: SafeMath-guarded transfer plus allowance decrement.
ERC20._transfer: internal SafeMath-guarded balance mutation.
ERC20._approve: internal allowance setter with zero-address checks.
ERC20._mint: internal supply/balance increase using SafeMath.
SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn: performs a low-level call to an external token contract with optional return-data decoding.
SafeMath.add: overflow-checked addition.
SafeMath.sub: underflow-checked subtraction.
SafeMath.mul: overflow-checked multiplication.
Address.isContract: extcodehash-based check that a target address is a contract.
Context._msgSender: returns msg.sender as address payable.
ERC20Detailed constructor: stores name, symbol and decimals.
msg.sender controls identity in transferFrom, approve, delegate, batchSend and owner assignment.
delegatecall to an attacker-supplied address with attacker-supplied calldata executed in the token's storage context.
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value, balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath.
Unchecked uint total = _value * _tos.length multiplication and balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total subtraction.
Low-level address(token).call(data) to an external token contract executing arbitrary calldata.
_from address parameter of StandardToken.transferFrom, drives the ensure modifier authorization.
_to recipient address parameter of StandardToken.transferFrom.
_value amount parameter of StandardToken.transferFrom and transfer.
Target address parameter a of StandardToken.delegate used as delegatecall destination.
Calldata bytes parameter b of StandardToken.delegate passed to delegatecall.
Recipient address array _tos parameter of StandardToken.batchSend.
Local total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend, computed without SafeMath.
Loop counter i in StandardToken.batchSend.
Local UNI address computed by pairFor inside the ensure modifier.
_supply parameter of the StandardToken constructor used as totalSupply.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _from is only meaningful as an argument of StandardToken.transferFrom and its ensure guard.
Parameter _to is consumed exclusively by StandardToken.transferFrom.
Parameter _value is consumed exclusively by StandardToken.transferFrom and transfer.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target used only by StandardToken.delegate.
Parameter b is the delegatecall calldata used only by StandardToken.delegate.
Parameter _tos is iterated only inside StandardToken.batchSend.
Local total is computed and consumed only inside StandardToken.batchSend.
Loop counter i exists only inside the StandardToken.batchSend loop.
Local UNI is computed by pairFor only for the ensure modifier check.
Parameter _supply is assigned to totalSupply only in the StandardToken constructor.
